```{r}
#| label: schedule-table

library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(lubridate)

# --- Input data ---
lec <- tibble::tribble(
  ~date,        ~event,                                                                  ~page,
  "2026-09-28", "Lecture 1: Course Logistics; Intro to R & Markdown",                    "01-home.qmd",
  "2026-09-30", "Lecture 2: Git & GitHub with R Studio",                                 "02-home.qmd",
  "2026-10-01", "Assignment 1 Open",                                                     "",
  "2026-10-05", "Lecture 3: Intro to ggplot2; Coding Style",                             "03-home.qmd",
  "2026-10-07", "Lecture 4: Graphs for Data Analysis with ggplot2",                      "04-home.qmd",
  "2026-10-08", "<strong>Assignment 1 Due</strong>",                                                      "",
  "2026-10-12", "Lecture 5: Intro to dplyr; Pipes",                                      "05-home.qmd",
  "2026-10-14", "Lecture 6: Intermediate dplyr; Renaming & Recoding Variables",          "06-home.qmd",
  "2026-10-15", "Assignment 2 Open",                                                     "",
  "2026-10-19", "Lecture 7: Missing Data; Factors",                                      "07-home.qmd",
  "2026-10-21", "Lecture 8: Tidy Data with tidyr; Regex with stringr",                   "08-home.qmd",
  "2026-10-22", "<strong>Assignment 2 Due</strong>",                                                      "",
  "2026-10-26", "Lecture 9: Importing Data with readr; Relational Data with dplyr",      "09-home.qmd",
  "2026-10-28", "Lecture 10: Exam 1; Intro to lubridate",                                "10-home.qmd",
  "2026-10-28", "<strong>In-Class Exam 1</strong>",                                                       "",
  "2026-10-29", "Assignment 3 Open",                                                     "",
  "2026-11-02", "Lecture 11: Data Structures and Base R",                                "11-home.qmd",
  "2026-11-04", "Lecture 12: Control Flow with Conditionals",                            "12-home.qmd",
  "2026-11-05", "<strong>Assignment 3 Due</strong>",                                                      "",
  "2026-11-05", "Final Project Open",                                                     "",
  "2026-11-09", "Lecture 13: Control Flow with Loops",                                   "13-home.qmd",
  "2026-11-11", "Lecture 14: Control Flow with Loops (cont.); Functions",                "14-home.qmd",
  "2026-11-12", "Assignment 4 Open",                                                     "",
  "2026-11-16", "Lecture 15: Functions (cont.); Reproducible Workflow",                  "15-home.qmd",
  "2026-11-18", "Lecture 16: Web-Scraping 1",                                            "16-home.qmd",
  "2026-11-19", "<strong>Assignment 4 Due</strong>",                                                      "",
  "2026-11-30", "Lecture 17: Web-Scraping 2",                                            "17-home.qmd",
  "2026-12-02", "Lecture 18: Exam 2; Final Project Check-In",                            "18-home.qmd",
  "2026-12-02", "<strong>In-Class Exam 2</strong>",                                                       "",
  "2026-12-06", "<strong>Assignment 5 (Final Project) Due</strong>",                                                     ""
)

# --- Transform: classify and create links ---
schedule <- lec |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    page = as.character(page),
    page_html = ifelse(
      is.na(page) | page == "",
      NA_character_,
      sub("\\.(qmd|Rmd)$", ".html", page)
    ),
    week_start = floor_date(date, unit = "week", week_start = 1),
    DateFull = format(date, "%a, %b %d"),

    # classify rows for styling
    is_open = grepl("Open$", event, ignore.case = TRUE),
    is_due_or_exam = grepl("Due</strong>$|^<strong>In-Class Exam|Due$", event, ignore.case = TRUE),

    # link any row that has a page
    `Lecture & Assessment` = case_when(
      !is.na(page_html) ~ sprintf(
        '<a href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener">%s</a>',
        page_html,
        event
      ),
      TRUE ~ event
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(date) |>
  mutate(
    week_index = dplyr::dense_rank(week_start)
  ) |>
  group_by(week_index) |>
  mutate(
    Week = if_else(row_number() == 1, paste0("Week ", week_index), "")
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(date) |>
  mutate(
    Date = if_else(
      row_number() == 1 | grepl("^<strong>In-Class Exam", event),
      gsub(" ", "&nbsp;", first(DateFull)),
      ""
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup()

# --- Build table ---
kbl <- schedule |>
  select(Week, Date, `Lecture & Assessment`) |>
  kable(
    format = "html",
    table.attr = 'id="schedule-table" class="table table-sm"',
    escape = FALSE,
    align = c("l", "l", "l")
  ) |>
  kable_styling(
    full_width = TRUE,
    bootstrap_options = c("condensed"),
    font_size = 16
  ) |>
  row_spec(0, background = "#d9eaf7", bold = TRUE) |>
  column_spec(1, width = "12%") |>   # Week
  column_spec(2, width = "18%") |>   # Date
  column_spec(3, width = "70%")      # Lecture & Assessment

# --- Add separators between weeks ---
week_end_rows <- schedule |>
  group_by(week_index) |>
  summarise(end_row = max(row_number()), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(end_row_cum = cumsum(end_row)) |>
  pull(end_row_cum)

if (length(week_end_rows) > 1) {
  week_end_rows <- head(week_end_rows, -1)

  for (r in week_end_rows) {
    kbl <- kbl |>
      row_spec(r, extra_css = "border-bottom: 1px solid #000 !important;")
  }
}

# Subtle styling for assessment rows
open_rows <- which(schedule$is_open)
due_exam_rows <- which(schedule$is_due_or_exam)

if (length(open_rows) > 0) {
  kbl <- kbl |>
    row_spec(open_rows, italic = TRUE, color = "#6c757d")
}

if (length(due_exam_rows) > 0) {
  kbl <- kbl |>
    row_spec(due_exam_rows, bold = TRUE, background = "#f7f7f7")
}

kbl
```

<small><em>Note: No lecture the week of Nov 23, 2026 (Thanksgiving Break).</em></small>
